Mv's translated closure supplies the shared copy engine after install's archive. Retain install.c and prog-fprintf.c while removing duplicate helpers, then revalidate install through the complete GNU suite.

selection_policy: The no-security mv closure is translated independently from cp and install because all three compile the shared copy engine with applet-specific main/usage renames; mv additionally owns mv.c and remove.c, and C2Rust requires unique source paths within each translation batch.
